scope: NSIS first-install empty-directory detection repair after actual parent-owned smoke failure
observedEvidence: Parent actual unsigned installer smoke failed; reviewed disposable installed-app directory exists and contains no entries. This Developer did not execute installer/uninstaller or modify that fixture.

Stock installer.nsi .onInit calls SetOutPath $INSTDIR before initMultiUser and customInit. initMultiUser then resolves current-user registration and /D via setInstallModePerUser/GetDParameter before invoking customInit.

Existing FileExists directory wildcard tests whether a directory exists and can match dot entries in an empty directory; requiring a safety marker solely on that condition rejects legitimate first installation after stock SetOutPath creates the directory.
changes: Replaced directory-existence wildcard check with movieRequireMarkerIfPopulated: GetFileAttributes verifies an existing ordinary directory; FindFirst/FindNext skip . and ..; any actual entry still requires the original application-ID/safe-uninstaller marker.

Missing targets are allowed only for normal file/path-not-found status; attribute/enum access failures, non-directory targets and unexpected enumeration errors fail closed. Enumeration handles close before marker validation and handled end-of-list clears the NSIS error flag.

Root validation now accepts only ASCII drive-letter:/backslash/ordinary child components or UNC server/share/child components. Rejects drive-relative/root-relative input, root-only targets, empty/repeated/trailing separators, slash mixing, traversal components, trailing dots/spaces, Win32 device names (including superscript COM/LPT names), control characters, ADS/wildcard/quote characters and unsupported >=260-character paths. Original PathIsRelative/PathIsRoot and ancestor reparse checks remain after this lexical guard.

Preserved all existing registered legacy-uninstaller, per-machine, --delete-app-data, root/ancestor/link, owned-file preflight and nonrecursive cleanup protections. No whitelist/removal policy was widened.
